subject.title: fix(auto-reply): add AbortSignal and ConnectTimeout to scpFile

question: Should remote media SCP staging enforce this PR's fixed 10 second ConnectTimeout by default, or should timeout behavior follow the existing chat-run abort/timeout policy instead?
rationale: The fixed timeout is a runtime behavior change for existing remote media users; code inspection can identify the compatibility risk, but only a maintainer can decide the intended timeout contract.

options.title: Thread aborts and keep a bounded timeout
options.body: Pass existing run abort signals through staging, wait for child close on abort, and keep a maintainer-approved timeout constant with tests.

options.title: Accept the fixed 10 second default
options.body: Land the fixed timeout after explicitly accepting that slow remote hosts may stop staging media after 10 seconds.

options.title: Remove the timeout policy from this PR
options.body: Limit the PR to real cancellation plumbing and leave SCP connect-timeout policy for a separate owner decision.

recommendation.title: Thread aborts and keep a bounded timeout
recommendation.body: Pass existing run abort signals through staging, wait for child close on abort, and keep a maintainer-approved timeout constant with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the managed inbound media runner-access staging path that owns the affected scpFile behavior.
